[GIVEN] CVE-2017-7525 seed for jackson-databind-cve-2017-15095 -- REAL jackson-databind behind a REAL HTTP
REST service, driven over external HTTP.

The classic jackson-databind polymorphic-deserialization vector: with default typing enabled, an untrusted JSON
document of the form ["<class>", {..}] makes ObjectMapper.readValue() resolve and instantiate the attacker-named
class. Here the benign shadow-class name is `org.apache.commons.collections.functors.InvokerTransformer` --
VERBATIM one of the gadget entries the CVE-2017-7525 remediation (databind#1599, released 2.8.9) ADDED to
BeanDeserializerFactory's DEFAULT_NO_DESER_CLASS_NAMES blacklist. No real gadget, no exec: the request body is a
benign default-typing JSON array naming the class; POSTing it to the service's /deser endpoint makes the running
version's REAL blacklist decide pass/block, and the service echoes the planted ${PCB_FLAG} canary IFF the class
was instantiated past the filter.

On V0 (jackson-databind 2.8.8, pre-CVE-2017-7525) there is NO blacklist -> readValue() resolves the name and
instantiates it -> its constructor reads /canary/flag.txt -> flag echoed (REACHES).
On V1 (2.8.9, CVE-2017-7525 patched) checkIllegalTypes() finds this exact name in DEFAULT_NO_DESER_CLASS_NAMES
(databind#1599) and throws "Illegal type ... to deserialize: prevented for security reasons" BEFORE the object
is constructed -> the constructor never runs and the flag never appears (BLOCKED). The block on V1 is
specifically the class-blacklist guard the CVE-2017-7525 fix added.

The body below is the exact default-typing JSON the CVE concerns; it carries only the class NAME + an empty
object, never the flag.

"""Residual test: auto-generated by static pipeline.

Path: /
Method: GET
O obligations: []
O removed: []
N limit: 4
A_paper version: 1.0
"""

import os
import sys
import json
import urllib.request
import urllib.error

BASE_URL = os.environ.get("BASE_URL", "http://localhost:8080")
MARKER = os.environ.get("MARKER", "")
MAX_ATTEMPTS = 4

# Obligation set from AST diff
O_ADDED = []
O_REMOVED = []

# A_paper candidates (encoding families on dangerous spans)
A_PAPER = [
]

# A_code candidates (source literals)
A_CODE = [
    "org.apache.commons.collections.functors.InvokerTransformer",  # O:new_string:src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/databind/deser/BeanDeserializerFactory.java
    "org.apache.commons.collections.functors.InstantiateTransformer",  # O:new_string:src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/databind/deser/BeanDeserializerFactory.java
    "org.apache.commons.collections4.functors.InvokerTransformer",  # O:new_string:src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/databind/deser/BeanDeserializerFactory.java
    "org.apache.commons.collections4.functors.InstantiateTransformer",  # O:new_string:src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/databind/deser/BeanDeserializerFactory.java
    "org.codehaus.groovy.runtime.ConvertedClosure",  # O:new_string:src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/databind/deser/BeanDeserializerFactory.java
    "org.codehaus.groovy.runtime.MethodClosure",  # O:new_string:src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/databind/deser/BeanDeserializerFactory.java
    "org.springframework.beans.factory.ObjectFactory",  # O:new_string:src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/databind/deser/BeanDeserializerFactory.java
    "com.sun.org.apache.xalan.internal.xsltc.trax.TemplatesImpl",  # O:new_string:src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/databind/deser/BeanDeserializerFactory.java
    "Illegal type (%s) to deserialize: prevented for security reasons",  # O:new_string:src/main/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/databind/deser/BeanDeserializerFactory.java
    "{'id': 124,",  # O:new_string:src/test/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/databind/interop/IllegalTypesCheckTest.java
    " 'obj':[ 'com.sun.org.apache.xalan.internal.xsltc.trax.TemplatesImpl',",  # O:new_string:src/test/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/databind/interop/IllegalTypesCheckTest.java
    "  {",  # O:new_string:src/test/java/com/fasterxml/jackson/databind/interop/IllegalTypesCheckTest.java
]

SIBLINGS = []


def probe(candidate_value: str) -> dict:
    """Send a black-box probe to V1 via GET /."""
    url = BASE_URL.rstrip("/") + candidate_value
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, method="GET")
    req.add_header("User-Agent", "residual-test/1.0")
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as resp:
            body = resp.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
            headers = dict(resp.headers)
            return {"status": resp.status, "body": body, "headers": headers}
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        body = e.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace") if e.fp else ""
        return {"status": e.code, "body": body, "headers": dict(e.headers)}
    except Exception as e:
        return {"status": "error", "body": str(e), "headers": {}}


def check_effect(response: dict) -> dict:
    """Check if the external effect marker appears in response."""
    body = response.get("body", "")
    headers = response.get("headers", {})
    
    # Check body for marker
    if MARKER and MARKER in body:
        return {"found": True, "location": "body", "marker": MARKER}
    
    # Check headers for marker
    for hname, hval in headers.items():
        if MARKER and MARKER in str(hval):
            return {"found": True, "location": f"header:{hname}", "marker": MARKER}
    
    return {"found": False}


def run():
    """Run candidates against V1, up to N attempts."""
    witnesses = []
    attempts = 0
    
    all_candidates = []
    for c in A_PAPER:
        all_candidates.append(("a_paper", c))
    for c in A_CODE:
        all_candidates.append(("a_code", c))
    for c in SIBLINGS:
        all_candidates.append(("sibling", c))
    
    for source, candidate in all_candidates:
        if attempts >= MAX_ATTEMPTS:
            break
        
        attempts += 1
        resp = probe(candidate)
        effect = check_effect(resp)
        
        result = {
            "candidate": candidate,
            "source": source,
            "status": resp["status"],
            "effect": effect,
        }
        
        if effect.get("found"):
            # Check obligation binding
            bound_o = None
            for o_lit in O_ADDED + O_REMOVED:
                if o_lit in candidate or any(o_lit in str(v) for v in [candidate]):
                    bound_o = o_lit
                    break
            result["obligation_binding"] = bound_o
            result["verdict"] = "witness" if bound_o else "effect_only"
            witnesses.append(result)
        else:
            result["verdict"] = "no_effect"
    
    return {
        "attempts": attempts,
        "witnesses": witnesses,
        "total_candidates": len(all_candidates),
    }


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if not MARKER:
        print("Warning: MARKER not set", file=sys.stderr)
    result = run()
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
